thread:
maya: Hey team — starting intake for thalia-12b (encoder-decoder) bring-up. Need to prioritize runtime compatibility checks before we do any quant experiments. TL;DR: check RoPE/ALiBi mapping, KV cache layout, attention dims, and first-pass perf/eval.

arjun: +1. timeline? do we want canary in Dedicated or just smoke in hosted first?

maya: prefer quick hosted smoke to catch obvious failures, then Dedicated canary once we have perf baseline. target: 1) inference correctness 2) no KV regressions 3) quantization sanity. aiming for initial pass today if bandwidth.

li: quick checklist I'm thinking (short):
- model metadata: config.json, vocab, tokenizer type
- architecture: encoder-decoder details (cross-attn keys/values shapes)
- RoPE/ALiBi: is it rotary on both enc/dec? positional emb mapping?
- KV cache layout: separate enc/dec caches, reuse rules
- dtype/weight layout: FP32/FP16/INT8 candidates
- test prompts: small encoder-only, decoder-only, long-context COT
- perf smoke: latency p50/p95, mem, token throughput
- golden outputs: small prompt set for exact-match checks

sam: adding: model uses ALiBi in decoder only per upstream docs (I think). need to verify offsets for cross-attention. also check whether rotary applies to encoder self-attn — mixing rotary+sinusoidal is a common gotcha.

carl: For KV cache: our runtime expects a single kv cache per attention block. ED models often have separate caches for encoder and decoder; runtime maps them differently. test with 1-step incremental decode and full-decode equivalence: 
``` 
# smoke script
python tests/decode_equivalence.py --model thalia-12b --prompt "Summarize: ..." --steps 10
```

maya: Good call. Also add tests for cross-attention cache invalidation when switching segments (e.g., different encoder inputs).

li: For RoPE specifically, run this quick shim to dump rotary coeffs and check max freq/scale: 
``` 
python tools/inspect_rope.py --model thalia-12b --layer 0 --dump ./tmp/rope_layer0.npy
# compare against runtime expected freq table
python tools/compare_rope.py ./tmp/rope_layer0.npy runtime/rope_table.npy
```

sam: If compare fails, often it's because the model uses 2D rotary or a different base freq. ping @arjun to handle runtime mapping.

arjun: If that happens, we need to add a mapping layer in loader: support alternate rope bases + shift. I can sketch a patch but will need a test vector.

carl: Also watch out for attention dim mismatches when concatenating KV along channel axis vs split heads. Some flavors of HF converted models store K/V as (batch, seq, heads, head_dim) vs our packed (batch, seq, heads*head_dim). We should add a converter step in converter/debug logs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: queued smoke-run on ci/pr-3587 for thalia-12b-smoke (env: hosted-smoke).

maya: Perf/priority note: put quant-INT8 experiments low priority until decoding equivalence and KV shape issues are clean. If we see consistent 1-2% quality drop in FP16->INT8, we'll need eval sets.

li: For evals, I prepared a mini-suite: 50-summary prompts, 30 Q/A, 20 code generation seeds. we'll run exact-match + rouge + embed-similarity. scripts under evals/thalia_baseline.

sam: can we get a quick baseline numbers from hosted-smoke? if p50 > 400ms or mem > 40GB per replica, deprioritize dedicated canary and dig into kernel selection.

arjun: noted. I'll watch the smoke run logs. if we get KV OOMs likely cause: unexpected seq_len or head_dim mismatch.

maya: OK folks — action items: arjun: add loader mapping + small test vector if needed. carl: add decode_equivalence script to thalia dir + converter logging. li: run rope dump + baseline evals. sam: monitor smoke job & post perf snapshot. i'll collate results and propose canary window.

carl: one more: add a quick CI test that runs encoder-only and decoder-only passes to catch cross-attn shape errors early. 30s runtime budget.

maya: thanks — will follow up with canary target tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
